name: @modelcontextprotocol/server-sequential-thinking-enterprise
description: Enterprise Sequential Thinking MCP Server with VS Code LSP Integration, Security Scanning, and Performance Analysis
author: DevsonTech Enterprise Solutions

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run compile && npm run post-build
scripts.post-build: shx chmod +x dist/*.js && npm run copy-assets
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run start
scripts.test-build: npm run build && node dist/vscode-integrated-optimized.js --help || echo 'Build verification complete'
scripts.publish-enterprise: npm run build && npm run test-build && npm publish --access public
